description: Update a Sentry issue: resolve, ignore (archive), or reopen it, assign it to a user or team, or change its priority.

ignoreCount.description: Occurrences before the issue stops being ignored. Only with ignoreMode `untilOccurrenceCount`.

ignoreUserCount.description: Affected users before the issue stops being ignored. Only with ignoreMode `untilUserCount`.
